caption: The drawing depicts a light brown, cylindrical collar at the top with a matching necktie tied in a knot and hanging down in two elongated, tapered ends. Below the collar and tie, there is a triangle with its point facing downward, drawn with clean black lines and divided into horizontal segments by five evenly spaced black horizontal lines. The background is a plain off-white or beige, and the lines and shading of the drawing appear to be rendered in pencil or a fine pen. The overall composition centers these elements vertically on the page. There is a faint handwritten signature in the lower right corner.
title: Cravat
